# Blood Rush

## Overview
Not every hunt is won through patience. Sometimes the Bloodhunter must close the distance before their prey can flee, cast a spell, or recover from its wounds. Blood Rush is the first technique that teaches a Bloodhunter to turn the power of Sangramancy inward, accelerating their own body instead of manipulating the blood of another.

By flooding their veins with mana and forcing their heart to beat beyond its natural rhythm, the Bloodhunter enters a brief state of heightened speed and awareness. Muscles respond instantly, breathing becomes effortless, and every instinct screams for the hunt to continue. To onlookers, the Bloodhunter appears to burst forward with unnatural acceleration, driven by a determination that borders on obsession.

Unlike Blood Rite, Blood Rush requires no blood sacrifice. Instead, the strain is placed upon the body itself. Mana fuels the Sangramancy, stamina keeps the body moving, and the emotional intensity generated by the technique feeds the Bloodhunter's growing Blood Points. Every activation is another reminder that even the pursuit of prey carries the risk of Bloodlust.

The Orders teach that Blood Rush is never to be used for retreat. Once the hunt begins, the Bloodhunter commits to seeing it through.

## Rank 1
### Description

Not every hunt is won through patience. Sometimes the Bloodhunter must close the distance before their prey can flee, cast a spell, or recover from its wounds. Blood Rush is the first technique that teaches a Bloodhunter to turn the power of Sangramancy inward, accelerating their own body instead of manipulating the blood of another.

By flooding their veins with mana and forcing their heart to beat beyond its natural rhythm, the Bloodhunter enters a brief state of heightened speed and awareness. Muscles respond instantly, breathing becomes effortless, and every instinct screams for the hunt to continue. To onlookers, the Bloodhunter appears to burst forward with unnatural acceleration, driven by a determination that borders on obsession.

Unlike Blood Rite, Blood Rush requires no blood sacrifice. Instead, the strain is placed upon the body itself. Mana fuels the Sangramancy, stamina keeps the body moving, and the emotional intensity generated by the technique feeds the Bloodhunter's growing Blood Points. Every activation is another reminder that even the pursuit of prey carries the risk of Bloodlust.

The Orders teach that Blood Rush is never to be used for retreat. Once the hunt begins, the Bloodhunter commits to seeing it through.

### Effects

- As a **Bonus Action**, activate Blood Rush.
- Spend **15 MP**, **15 SP**, and gain **5 Blood Points (BP)**.
- Blood Rush lasts for **2 Combat Rounds**.
- While Blood Rush is active:
  - Your movement speed increases by **3 metres**.
  - If you move at least **3 metres** towards your **Marked Prey**, gain **+1 to your first melee Attack Roll** against that target each turn.
- While Blood Rush is active, if you willingly end your movement **farther away from your Marked Prey** than where you started your movement, Blood Rush immediately ends.
- Blood Rush may only have one active instance at a time.

### Lore

Blood Rush is one of the first mobility techniques taught to Bloodhunters after they master Blood Rite. While many warriors rely upon disciplined footwork or physical training, Bloodhunters instead trust the power flowing through their own veins. Every heartbeat becomes another step in the hunt, every breath another promise that the prey will not escape.

Veteran hunters often describe Blood Rush as surrendering to instinct without surrendering to Bloodlust. For a few precious moments, the Bloodhunter allows the predatory nature awakened through Sangramancy to guide every movement, trusting years of training to keep the darkness in check.

Among the Orders, apprentices who misuse Blood Rush to flee from battle are required to retrain the technique from the beginning. The lesson is simple: Blood Rush was never created to escape danger. It exists so that no worthy prey can ever outrun the hunter sworn to pursue it.

> *"The hunt ends when my heart does—not when yours finds somewhere to hide."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 2
### Description

With greater experience, the Bloodhunter learns to sustain Blood Rush for longer without allowing the violent surge of Sangramancy to overwhelm their body. Their heart beats with unnatural speed, muscles are flooded with oxygen, and every movement becomes sharper and more deliberate. What once felt like a desperate burst of speed now becomes a controlled state of relentless pursuit.

The Bloodhunter no longer chases their prey—they pressure it. Every step forces the quarry into making mistakes, every burst of speed closes another avenue of escape, and every heartbeat reminds the Bloodhunter that the hunt is drawing to its inevitable conclusion.

Although Blood Rush no longer tears at the Bloodhunter's body, it still feeds the emotional storm within. The exhilaration of the chase, the anticipation of the kill, and the instinct to pursue all generate Blood Points, bringing the hunter ever closer to Bloodlust.

Veteran Bloodhunters teach that Blood Rush is not about moving faster than your prey. It is about making them realise that no matter how quickly they run, you are always gaining ground.

### Effects

- As a **Bonus Action**, activate Blood Rush.
- Spend **20 MP**, **20 SP**, and gain **10 Blood Points (BP)**.
- Blood Rush lasts for **2 Combat Rounds**.
- While Blood Rush is active:
  - Your movement speed increases by **4 metres**.
  - If you move at least **3 metres** towards your **Marked Prey**, gain **+1 to your first Attack Roll** and **+1 Damage** against that target each turn.
- While Blood Rush is active, if you willingly end your movement **farther away from your Marked Prey** than where you started your movement, Blood Rush immediately ends.
- Blood Rush may only have one active instance at a time.

### Lore

Among experienced Bloodhunters, Blood Rush is no longer viewed as a simple movement technique. It becomes a declaration that the hunt has entered its final stage. Once activated, the Bloodhunter abandons hesitation entirely, trusting instinct, training, and Sangramancy to guide every step toward their quarry.

Many monsters have mistaken Blood Rush for reckless aggression. Those that survive quickly realise the truth—it is a calculated pursuit. Every movement is measured, every path anticipated, and every escape route methodically closed until surrender or death becomes the prey's only remaining choice.

The elders remind every Bloodhunter that speed alone never wins a hunt. Discipline does. Blood Rush simply ensures that discipline arrives before the prey has the chance to disappear.

> *"You think I am chasing you. I stopped chasing long ago. Now I am simply deciding where this hunt ends."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 3
### Description

By the Third Rank, Blood Rush has become second nature to the Bloodhunter. Their body has adapted to the immense strain placed upon it by Sangramancy, allowing them to enter a state of heightened speed without sacrificing precision. Every heartbeat echoes through their veins like a battle drum, sharpening their instincts and preparing them for the hunt before blades are ever drawn.

Veteran Bloodhunters often activate Blood Rush the instant they sense their prey. Their heightened awareness allows them to react before others have even recognised the threat, turning hesitation into overwhelming momentum. Few creatures are prepared for a hunter that seems to move the very moment combat begins.

This heightened state does not simply increase speed—it awakens the Bloodhunter's predatory instincts. Every movement is focused on closing the distance, every attack is delivered with greater confidence, and every heartbeat drives them relentlessly toward their quarry.

Yet every accelerated heartbeat feeds the Bloodhunter's Blood Points. The exhilaration of the chase is intoxicating, and many Bloodhunters have learned too late that becoming addicted to the hunt is the first step towards Bloodlust.

### Effects

- As a **Bonus Action**, activate Blood Rush.
- Spend **25 MP**, **25 SP**, and gain **15 Blood Points (BP)**.
- Blood Rush lasts for **2 Combat Rounds**.
- While Blood Rush is active:
  - Your movement speed increases by **5 metres**.
  - Gain **+2 Initiative**.
  - If you move at least **3 metres** towards your **Marked Prey**, gain **+2 to your first Attack Roll** and **+1 Damage** against that target each turn.
- While Blood Rush is active, if you willingly end your movement **farther away from your Marked Prey** than where you started your movement, Blood Rush immediately ends.
- Blood Rush may only have one active instance at a time.

### Lore

Within the Bloodhunter Orders, Rank III marks the moment a hunter truly earns the title of predator. No longer reacting to danger, they become the one dictating the pace of every encounter. Their heartbeat quickens, their senses sharpen, and their prey suddenly finds itself fighting a hunter who was ready before the battle even began.

Masters often compare Blood Rush to a wolf beginning its chase. The first few steps determine the outcome of the hunt, and hesitation is the difference between success and starvation. A Bloodhunter who has mastered this technique understands that momentum is a weapon every bit as deadly as steel.

The elders caution that Blood Rush is addictive. The thrill of moving faster than any ordinary warrior and reaching prey before it can escape is exhilarating. Those who become obsessed with that feeling often find themselves activating Blood Rush long before it is necessary, unknowingly feeding the Bloodlust that waits patiently within.

> *"The battle begins when others draw their weapons. My hunt begins with the first heartbeat."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 4
### Description

At the Fourth Rank, Blood Rush becomes a terrifying display of controlled Sangramancy. The Bloodhunter has learned to regulate the violent surge of blood racing through their body, allowing them to move with incredible speed while maintaining absolute focus on the hunt. Every heartbeat is deliberately accelerated, flooding muscles with strength and sharpening instincts beyond mortal limits.

To witnesses, the Bloodhunter appears almost impossible to pin down. They weave between enemies, close impossible distances, and remain relentlessly fixed upon their prey. Those attempting to intercept them often strike nothing but empty air as the Bloodhunter slips past in pursuit of their target.

Despite this mastery, the technique remains dangerous. The Bloodhunter willingly drives their body beyond its natural limits, embracing the exhilaration of the chase while Blood Points rapidly accumulate. Veterans understand that the greatest threat is no longer physical exhaustion, but the growing temptation to remain in this heightened state forever.

Within the Bloodhunter Orders, Rank IV is known as **The Crimson Pursuit**, for it is said that once a Bloodhunter enters this state, even the fastest prey begins to realise there is nowhere left to run.

### Effects

- As a **Bonus Action**, activate Blood Rush.
- Spend **35 MP**, **30 SP**, and gain **20 Blood Points (BP)**.
- Blood Rush lasts for **2 Combat Rounds**.
- While Blood Rush is active:
  - Your movement speed increases by **6 metres**.
  - Gain **+3 Initiative**.
  - Opportunity Attacks made against you suffer **-2 to their Attack Rolls**.
  - If you move at least **3 metres** towards your **Marked Prey**, gain **+2 to your first Attack Roll** and **+2 Damage** against that target each turn.
- If you willingly end your movement **farther away from your Marked Prey** than where you started your movement, Blood Rush immediately ends.
- Blood Rush may only have one active instance at a time.

### Lore

The Fourth Rank is where Blood Rush ceases to be a burst of speed and becomes an extension of the Bloodhunter's identity. Their pursuit is no longer driven by anger or desperation, but by unwavering purpose. Every movement is efficient, every stride calculated, and every heartbeat serves a single goal—to end the hunt.

Many monsters speak of encountering Bloodhunters capable of appearing wherever escape seemed possible. They are not teleporting, nor are they bending time. They simply understand momentum so completely that every movement flows seamlessly into the next, leaving no opportunity for their prey to recover.

Masters caution that this level of Sangramancy can become intoxicating. The thrill of overwhelming speed, perfect control, and absolute pursuit is seductive. Those who begin chasing the feeling instead of the prey often discover that Bloodlust has quietly begun chasing them in return.

> *"You can outrun my footsteps... but you'll never outrun my heartbeat."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 5
### Description

The Fifth Rank of Blood Rush represents the pinnacle of physical Sangramancy. Every beat of the Bloodhunter's heart becomes a catalyst for overwhelming speed, allowing them to pursue their prey with relentless precision. Their blood surges through every vein with incredible force, pushing their body to the very limits of mortal endurance while their mind remains unnervingly calm.

To those watching the hunt unfold, the Bloodhunter appears almost impossible to escape. They cover impossible distances in moments, effortlessly weaving through the chaos of battle while their eyes never leave their chosen prey. Every movement is purposeful, every stride calculated, and every heartbeat carries the certainty that the hunt will end exactly where the Bloodhunter chooses.

Yet this mastery demands immense discipline. The rush of power is intoxicating, and the Bloodhunter willingly embraces a torrent of Blood Points every time they unleash their full potential. Veterans understand that Blood Rush is no longer simply a technique—it is a constant test of self-control. One careless activation while already nearing Bloodlust can transform the hunter into the very monster they have spent their life pursuing.

Among the Bloodhunter Orders, this mastery is known as **The Crimson Pursuit**, for once a Bloodhunter reaches this stage, very few creatures ever escape alive.

### Effects

- As a **Bonus Action**, activate Blood Rush.
- Spend **45 MP**, **35 SP**, and gain **25 Blood Points (BP)**.
- Blood Rush lasts for **2 Combat Rounds**.
- While Blood Rush is active:
  - Your movement speed increases by **8 metres**.
  - Gain **+4 Initiative**.
  - Opportunity Attacks made against you suffer **-4 to their Attack Rolls**.
  - If you move at least **3 metres** towards your **Marked Prey**, gain **+3 to your first Attack Roll** and **+3 Damage** against that target each turn.
- If you willingly end your movement farther away from your **Marked Prey** than where you started your movement, Blood Rush immediately ends.
- Blood Rush may only have one active instance at a time.

### Lore

Only the greatest Bloodhunters ever master the Fifth Rank of Blood Rush. Their heartbeat has become as much a weapon as the blade they carry, allowing them to relentlessly pursue prey across battlefields, forests, and ruined cities without ever surrendering momentum. Many monsters have mistaken the sudden silence before their death as safety, only to find the Bloodhunter already standing behind them.

Masters teach that Blood Rush is not about becoming the fastest warrior alive. It is about becoming the one creature your prey can never escape. Every lesson, every sacrifice, and every hunt leads to this singular truth: the Bloodhunter decides when the chase ends.

The elders leave every apprentice with the same warning. Speed is intoxicating, and the thrill of the hunt is one of the strongest emotions Sangramancy can amplify. The Bloodhunter who begins chasing that feeling instead of their prey has already taken the first step towards Bloodlust. True masters never forget that they command the hunt—the hunt must never command them.

> *"Run until your heart bursts if you wish. Mine has already decided where yours will stop beating."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

None

# Blood Shield

## Overview
Blood Shield is one of the first defensive applications of Sangramancy taught within the Bloodhunter Orders. Rather than turning their blood into a weapon, the Bloodhunter willingly sacrifices a portion of their own life force, drawing fresh blood from beneath their skin and suspending it in the air through the power of mana.

The blood rapidly hardens into a thin crimson barrier that circles the Bloodhunter like a living shield. Although delicate in appearance, the enchanted blood is capable of deflecting blades, arrows, and magical attacks before instantly reforming around its master. Every strike absorbed by the shield reminds the Bloodhunter that their own blood is both their greatest weapon and their greatest defence.

Unlike conventional armour, Blood Shield demands sacrifice. The Bloodhunter willingly weakens themselves to create a barrier capable of preserving their life during the most dangerous moments of battle. Veterans often describe the technique as placing complete trust in Sangramancy, believing that a small wound now is worth surviving a fatal blow later.

The Orders teach that Blood Shield should never become a crutch. Every activation sheds blood, fuels Blood Points, and edges the Bloodhunter closer to Bloodlust. A wise hunter knows that the strongest shield is not one that is used constantly, but one that is summoned only when death is certain to follow without it.

## Rank 1
### Description

Blood Shield is one of the first defensive applications of Sangramancy taught within the Bloodhunter Orders. Rather than turning their blood into a weapon, the Bloodhunter willingly sacrifices a portion of their own life force, drawing fresh blood from beneath their skin and suspending it in the air through the power of mana.

The blood rapidly hardens into a thin crimson barrier that circles the Bloodhunter like a living shield. Although delicate in appearance, the enchanted blood is capable of deflecting blades, arrows, and magical attacks before instantly reforming around its master. Every strike absorbed by the shield reminds the Bloodhunter that their own blood is both their greatest weapon and their greatest defence.

Unlike conventional armour, Blood Shield demands sacrifice. The Bloodhunter willingly weakens themselves to create a barrier capable of preserving their life during the most dangerous moments of battle. Veterans often describe the technique as placing complete trust in Sangramancy, believing that a small wound now is worth surviving a fatal blow later.

The Orders teach that Blood Shield should never become a crutch. Every activation sheds blood, fuels Blood Points, and edges the Bloodhunter closer to Bloodlust. A wise hunter knows that the strongest shield is not one that is used constantly, but one that is summoned only when death is certain to follow without it.

### Effects

- As a **Bonus Action**, activate Blood Shield.
- Spend **20 MP**, sacrifice **5 HP**, and gain **5 Blood Points (BP)**.
- Blood Shield lasts for **2 Combat Rounds**.
- While Blood Shield is active, gain **+2 Armour Class (AC)**.
- Blood Shield is considered a **magical effect**.
- Only one Blood Shield may be active at a time.
- Blood Points gained through Blood Shield count towards your **Blood Point Limit** and may contribute to triggering **Bloodlust**.

### Lore

Among experienced Bloodhunters, Blood Shield is considered a symbol of absolute faith in Sangramancy. The hunter willingly spills their own blood before the enemy has the chance, trusting that the sacrifice made now will preserve their life long enough to complete the hunt.

The crimson shield has become an unmistakable sight upon battlefields across Asteria. Monsters that recognise its appearance know they face a Bloodhunter willing to sacrifice their own life to ensure the hunt continues. Many have broken their weapons against the shimmering barrier, only to watch the blood reform as though it possessed a will of its own.

The elders remind every apprentice that blood is sacred. To shape it into a shield is not merely a display of power, but a promise that every drop sacrificed will be repaid through the successful completion of the hunt.

> *"The first blood I spill in every battle is my own. Every drop after that belongs to my prey."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 2
### Description

As a Bloodhunter's mastery of Sangramancy deepens, so too does their ability to shape their own lifeblood into a resilient defensive barrier. The once thin crimson shield becomes denser and more stable, its surface constantly flowing and reforming as fresh mana courses through the Bloodhunter's veins.

The shield no longer merely deflects attacks—it anticipates them. Each strike causes the living blood to ripple across its surface before instantly hardening again, dispersing the force of incoming blows. To an observer, it appears as though the Bloodhunter is surrounded by a crimson halo that instinctively moves to intercept danger.

Maintaining such a shield requires a greater sacrifice than before. More blood must be offered, more mana must sustain its form, and the Bloodhunter's emotions surge alongside the flow of Sangramancy. Every heartbeat strengthens the barrier while simultaneously feeding the Blood Points accumulating within the hunter.

Veterans often teach that Blood Shield should not be viewed as armour, but as a promise. Every drop of blood willingly sacrificed is another declaration that the hunt will continue, regardless of the wounds yet to come.

### Effects

- As a **Bonus Action**, activate Blood Shield.
- Spend **25 MP**, sacrifice **8 HP**, and gain **10 Blood Points (BP)**.
- Blood Shield lasts for **3 Combat Rounds**.
- While Blood Shield is active, gain **+2 Armour Class (AC)**.
- Blood Shield is considered a **magical effect**.
- Only one Blood Shield may be active at a time.
- Blood Points gained through Blood Shield count towards your **Blood Point Limit** and may contribute to triggering **Bloodlust**.

### Lore

Among the Bloodhunter Orders, Rank II is seen as the point where the shield begins to feel alive. Apprentices no longer force the blood into shape through sheer will alone. Instead, they learn to allow Sangramancy to guide its movement, creating a barrier that responds almost instinctively to danger.

Many Bloodhunters describe hearing the rhythm of their own heartbeat within the shield itself. Every pulse reinforces its strength, reminding the hunter that the barrier exists only because they willingly gave a part of themselves to create it.

The elders caution that Blood Shield is never truly free. Every activation strengthens the Bloodhunter's resolve, but it also deepens their connection to the darkness carried within their blood. A shield born from sacrifice will always demand another sacrifice before the hunt is over.

> *"Steel may guard the body, but only sacrifice can protect the soul."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 3
### Description

At the Third Rank, Blood Shield becomes a true manifestation of Sangramancy. The Bloodhunter has mastered the delicate balance between sacrifice and control, allowing greater quantities of their own blood to leave the body without losing cohesion. The crimson barrier grows thicker, stronger, and far more resilient, rotating around the Bloodhunter in a constant orbit of living blood.

Each impact against the shield sends crimson ripples across its surface before it reforms almost instantly. Blades glance away, arrows are deflected, and spells collide against a barrier sustained by both blood and willpower. Every heartbeat reinforces the shield, binding it ever closer to the Bloodhunter's life force.

The shield is not merely protection—it is a declaration. Every enemy that witnesses Blood Shield understands they face a warrior willing to sacrifice their own life to survive long enough to complete the hunt. Such determination alone has broken the morale of many monsters before the first blow is ever struck.

Yet greater protection demands greater sacrifice. More blood is drawn from the body, more mana is consumed to sustain the barrier, and the Bloodhunter's Blood Points rise with every activation. The stronger the shield becomes, the louder the call of Bloodlust grows.

### Effects

- As a **Bonus Action**, activate Blood Shield.
- Spend **35 MP**, sacrifice **12 HP**, and gain **15 Blood Points (BP)**.
- Blood Shield lasts for **3 Combat Rounds**.
- While Blood Shield is active, gain **+3 Armour Class (AC)**.
- Blood Shield is considered a **magical effect**.
- Only one Blood Shield may be active at a time.
- Blood Points gained through Blood Shield count towards your **Blood Point Limit** and may contribute towards triggering **Bloodlust**.

### Lore

Bloodhunters who master the Third Rank are recognised throughout the Orders as warriors capable of standing against creatures far stronger than themselves. Their Blood Shield is no longer viewed as a desperate defence, but as an extension of their own resolve. Every drop of blood sacrificed becomes another promise that the hunt will not end until justice has been delivered.

Experienced Bloodhunters often describe the sensation as carrying a second heartbeat around their body. The crimson barrier pulses in perfect rhythm with their own heart, responding instinctively to danger as though it possesses a life of its own.

The elders continue to remind every apprentice that no shield lasts forever. Blood Shield is not intended to make a Bloodhunter invincible—it exists to buy precious moments when death seems inevitable. Those moments are often all a true hunter needs.

> *"Every strike against my shield reminds me that I chose this pain before my enemy ever could."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 4
### Description

The Fourth Rank of Blood Shield marks the point where Sangramancy becomes an unshakable bastion rather than a simple defence. The Bloodhunter can now draw forth a far greater quantity of their own blood, shaping it into a dense crimson barrier that constantly circles their body like a vigilant guardian. Every heartbeat strengthens the shield, reinforcing its structure before the enemy can exploit even the smallest weakness.

Unlike steel or enchanted armour, Blood Shield is alive. It shifts, twists, and flows around incoming attacks, instinctively placing itself between the Bloodhunter and danger. Blades glance away, arrows are deflected from their mark, and magical energy crashes harmlessly against the crimson barrier before dissolving into crimson mist.

Such mastery demands tremendous sacrifice. The Bloodhunter willingly offers more of their own life to sustain the shield, trusting that every drop of blood given now will preserve countless more before the hunt is over. The emotions stirred by this sacrifice surge through Sangramancy, rapidly increasing the Bloodhunter's Blood Points and testing their resolve against the ever-present threat of Bloodlust.

Within the Bloodhunter Orders, reaching this rank is considered proof that a hunter has learned to trust their blood completely, knowing that the strongest defence is often forged from the greatest sacrifice.

### Effects

- As a **Bonus Action**, activate Blood Shield.
- Spend **45 MP**, sacrifice **16 HP**, and gain **20 Blood Points (BP)**.
- Blood Shield lasts for **4 Combat Rounds**.
- While Blood Shield is active, gain **+4 Armour Class (AC)**.
- Blood Shield is considered a **magical effect**.
- Only one Blood Shield may be active at a time.
- Blood Points gained through Blood Shield count towards your **Blood Point Limit** and may contribute to triggering **Bloodlust**.

### Lore

Among the Bloodhunter Orders, the Fourth Rank is known as **The Crimson Bastion**. Bloodhunters who achieve this level no longer fear standing before overwhelming foes, for they know that every sacrifice strengthens the shield protecting them. Their confidence does not come from arrogance, but from absolute faith in the Sangramancy flowing through their veins.

Stories tell of Bloodhunters standing against charging giants, dragonfire, and swarms of monsters while their crimson barrier absorbed blow after blow. Those who witnessed these battles often believed the Bloodhunter was protected by divine intervention, never realising the shield was sustained solely by the hunter's own blood and unwavering determination.

The elders caution that every shield eventually fades. A Bloodhunter who believes themselves untouchable has already taken the first step toward Bloodlust. The shield exists to preserve the hunter long enough to complete the hunt—not to replace skill, discipline, or wisdom.

> *"A fortress built of stone will one day crumble. A fortress built of sacrifice stands for as long as its guardian draws breath."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 5
### Description

The Fifth Rank of Blood Shield represents the pinnacle of defensive Sangramancy. Through complete mastery over their own lifeblood, the Bloodhunter can create a magnificent crimson barrier that continuously circles their body, moving with a will that mirrors their own. Every heartbeat feeds the shield, allowing it to reshape itself in an instant to intercept blades, arrows, spells, and monstrous claws before they can reach the Bloodhunter.

The barrier appears almost ethereal, formed from countless strands of enchanted blood flowing together in perfect harmony. It is neither armour nor magic alone, but a living extension of the Bloodhunter's soul. Each strike against the shield sends crimson ripples across its surface before it reforms without hesitation, standing as a testament to the hunter's willingness to sacrifice themselves for victory.

Such mastery comes at an immense price. The Bloodhunter must willingly surrender a significant portion of their own life force, trusting that Sangramancy will preserve them long enough to complete the hunt. Every activation floods their body with powerful emotions, dramatically increasing their Blood Points and bringing them perilously close to Bloodlust.

Among the Bloodhunter Orders, only the greatest masters ever achieve this technique. They are known as the **Crimson Wardens**, hunters whose blood alone is said to be stronger than steel.

### Effects

- As a **Bonus Action**, activate Blood Shield.
- Spend **60 MP**, sacrifice **20 HP**, and gain **25 Blood Points (BP)**.
- Blood Shield lasts for **5 Combat Rounds**.
- While Blood Shield is active, gain **+5 Armour Class (AC)**.
- Blood Shield is considered a **magical effect**.
- Only one Blood Shield may be active at a time.
- Blood Points gained through Blood Shield count towards your **Blood Point Limit** and may contribute to triggering **Bloodlust**.

### Lore

To become a Crimson Warden is to place absolute faith in Sangramancy. The Bloodhunter no longer questions whether their blood will protect them—they know it will. Every sacrifice strengthens the bond between hunter and shield until the barrier becomes as natural as the heartbeat that sustains it.

Legends tell of Bloodhunters standing alone against overwhelming armies while crimson shields danced around them like living guardians. Arrows shattered, enchanted weapons glanced away, and monstrous blows were turned aside by nothing more than blood willingly given in the name of the hunt. Those fortunate enough to witness such feats rarely forget the sight.

Yet every master teaches the same final lesson. The Blood Shield is not the source of a Bloodhunter's strength—it is merely a reflection of it. The true shield has always been the unwavering resolve to sacrifice everything necessary to protect others from the horrors that stalk the world. Blood may form the barrier, but conviction is what truly makes it unbreakable.

> *"Steel protects the body. Blood protects the hunter. Conviction protects the soul."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

Every Bloodhunter understands that Sangramancy is a cycle of sacrifice and reward. Blood fuels power, power fuels Bloodlust, and Bloodlust must eventually be brought back under control. Blood Tithe is the sacred ritual that maintains this balance.

Rather than drawing upon mana, the Bloodhunter willingly offers a portion of their own life force as a tithe. The sacrificed blood is consumed by Sangramancy, calming the turmoil raging within the hunter's soul while restoring the strength needed to continue the hunt. The Bloodhunter acknowledges the darkness building within themselves and willingly pays a greater price before it can consume them. Within the Bloodhunter Orders, apprentices are taught that every hunt is measured not by the monsters slain, but by how many times the hunter successfully mastered the monster growing within themselves.

### Lore

Among the Bloodhunter Orders, Blood Tithe is regarded as one of the most important techniques a hunter can learn. Every Bloodhunter inevitably walks the razor's edge between mastery and Bloodlust, and only those who learn to temper their emotions survive long enough to become veterans.

The ritual is performed differently by every Order. Some carve symbols into their palms, others allow blood to drip onto ancient runestones, while some simply whisper a silent oath before offering their sacrifice. Regardless of tradition, the purpose remains the same—to remind the Bloodhunter that power without restraint is the quickest path to ruin.

The elders often tell apprentices that Blood Tithe is not an act of weakness. It is the greatest display of strength a Bloodhunter can perform, for it proves they still command their own blood rather than allowing their blood to command them.

> *"The greatest sacrifice is not the blood you spill upon the battlefield... it is the blood you willingly offer to remain yourself."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 2
### Description

As a Bloodhunter grows stronger, so too does their understanding of balance. Every use of Sangramancy pushes them closer to Bloodlust, but Blood Tithe allows them to reclaim a measure of control through deliberate sacrifice. Rather than fearing the darkness within, experienced Bloodhunters learn to manage it, paying a blood tithe before it can overwhelm them.

At this stage, the ritual becomes far more efficient. The Bloodhunter has refined the flow of Sangramancy through their body, allowing a greater portion of the sacrificed life force to be transformed into renewed strength. Mana is restored with greater clarity, stamina returns more quickly, and the emotional burden carried within their blood begins to settle.

Veterans often perform Blood Tithe in the brief moments between battles, recognising that the hunt is rarely won through brute strength alone. Endurance, discipline, and restraint are every bit as important as the blade carried into combat.

Although the ritual calms the Bloodhunter's spirit, it never comes without consequence. The blood offered cannot be reclaimed, and every sacrifice leaves another reminder that true power is earned through suffering rather than granted freely.

### Effects

- As a **Bonus Action**, activate Blood Tithe.
- Sacrifice **15 HP**.
- Choose **one** of the following:
  - Restore **25 Mana Points (MP)**.
  - Restore **25 Stamina Points (SP)**.
- Reduce your current **Blood Points (BP) by 10**.
- Blood Tithe cannot restore HP.
- Blood Tithe cannot restore MP or SP beyond their normal maximum values.
- Blood Tithe may only be used while you have at least **10 Blood Points**.

### Lore

Within the Bloodhunter Orders, Rank II is considered the first step towards true emotional discipline. Apprentices learn that surviving a hunt requires more than defeating monsters—it requires surviving the conflict raging within themselves. Every successful Blood Tithe is proof that the Bloodhunter still commands their own destiny rather than surrendering to Bloodlust.

Many masters describe the ritual as a conversation with Sangramancy itself. The Bloodhunter willingly offers blood, and in return receives only enough strength to continue the hunt—never more than they have earned. This sacred exchange reminds every hunter that sacrifice and discipline must always remain in balance.

The elders caution that Blood Tithe should never become a crutch. A hunter who constantly relies upon it without learning restraint will eventually discover that no amount of sacrifice can restore a soul that has already surrendered to Bloodlust.

> *"Power is easy to claim. Wisdom is knowing when to surrender a little of it to remain yourself."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 3
### Description

The Third Rank of Blood Tithe marks the moment a Bloodhunter truly understands the balance between sacrifice and restraint. Sangramancy is no longer viewed as an uncontrollable force that threatens to consume them, but as a living current that can be guided through discipline, experience, and unwavering resolve.

When performing Blood Tithe, the Bloodhunter willingly opens a deeper wound, offering a greater portion of their own life force to restore what has been exhausted. The ritual is painful, but it clears the mind and steadies the heart, allowing the Bloodhunter to continue the hunt with renewed focus. Every drop of blood offered is a conscious decision to remain in control rather than surrender to Bloodlust.

Veteran Bloodhunters often perform this ritual in the brief moments between fierce exchanges, knowing that the greatest enemy is not always standing before them. Sometimes the true battle is fought within, where every Blood Point tempts the hunter to abandon reason for overwhelming power.

The Orders teach that Blood Tithe is not a means of avoiding Bloodlust forever. It is simply another tool that allows a disciplined hunter to decide when they are willing to embrace the darkness—and when they are not.

### Effects

- As a **Bonus Action**, activate Blood Tithe.
- Sacrifice **20 HP**.
- Choose **one** of the following:
  - Restore **40 Mana Points (MP)**.
  - Restore **40 Stamina Points (SP)**.
- Reduce your current **Blood Points (BP)** by **15**.
- Blood Tithe cannot restore HP.
- Blood Tithe cannot restore MP or SP beyond their normal maximum values.
- Blood Tithe may only be used while you have at least **15 Blood Points**.

### Lore

Within every Bloodhunter Order, Rank III is considered the beginning of true mastery over Sangramancy. The Bloodhunter has learned that strength is not measured by how much blood they can spill, but by how much they are willing to sacrifice without losing themselves.

Masters often describe Blood Tithe as a ritual of humility. The hunter willingly weakens themselves so that they may continue protecting others, proving that sacrifice remains the foundation of every Bloodhunter's path. Those who perform the ritual without respect quickly discover that Sangramancy rewards discipline, not recklessness.

The elders remind every apprentice that Bloodlust is never defeated—it is only held at bay. Blood Tithe is one of the few techniques capable of quieting its whispers, but even the greatest Bloodhunters know those whispers will always return when the next hunt begins.

> *"Control is not the absence of darkness. It is choosing, every single day, not to let the darkness choose for you."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 4
### Description

Few Bloodhunters ever master the Fourth Rank of Blood Tithe. At this stage, the ritual is no longer simply an exchange of blood for strength—it becomes an act of absolute discipline. The Bloodhunter has learned to willingly surrender a significant portion of their own life force, trusting that Sangramancy will return only what is necessary while calming the turmoil threatening to erupt into Bloodlust.

The ritual is performed with unwavering precision. A deep cut is made, blood is offered, and ancient Sangramantic runes briefly ignite around the wound before fading into crimson mist. As the offering is accepted, the Bloodhunter feels exhaustion melt away and the relentless pressure of Blood Points begin to subside. Their breathing steadies, their heartbeat slows, and clarity returns to a mind that moments before stood dangerously close to losing control.

Veterans often reserve Blood Tithe for the most desperate moments of a hunt. They understand that sacrificing more blood now may be the only reason they survive long enough to finish what they started. Every use is a reminder that true mastery is measured not by how much power one possesses, but by knowing when to relinquish it.

### Effects

- As a **Bonus Action**, activate Blood Tithe.
- Sacrifice **25 HP**.
- Choose **one** of the following:
  - Restore **60 Mana Points (MP)**.
  - Restore **60 Stamina Points (SP)**.
- Reduce your current **Blood Points (BP)** by **20**.
- Blood Tithe cannot restore HP.
- Blood Tithe cannot restore MP or SP beyond their normal maximum values.
- Blood Tithe may only be used while you have at least **20 Blood Points**.

### Lore

Within the Bloodhunter Orders, Rank IV is known as **The Crimson Offering**. It represents the moment a Bloodhunter proves they can command Sangramancy without allowing Sangramancy to command them. Every offering made through this ritual demonstrates a level of discipline few hunters ever achieve.

Many masters teach that Blood Tithe is not merely a recovery technique—it is a reminder of why the Bloodhunter fights. Every sacrifice reinforces the oath taken upon entering the Orders: to willingly endure suffering so that others never have to face the horrors lurking beyond civilisation alone.

The elders warn that even the greatest Bloodhunter must never become complacent. Bloodlust is patient. It waits beyond every battle, every victory, and every sacrifice. Blood Tithe does not destroy that darkness—it merely reminds it who remains in control.

> *"Every drop I surrender is another promise that the darkness will serve me... never the other way around."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 5
### Description

At the Fifth Rank, Blood Tithe becomes the ultimate expression of a Bloodhunter's discipline over Sangramancy. Few warriors possess the resolve to willingly surrender so much of their own life force, yet the greatest Bloodhunters understand that true mastery has never been about gaining power—it has always been about knowing when to relinquish it.

The ritual has become instinctive. A single deliberate wound is enough to begin the ancient exchange. Blood leaves the body, crimson runes flare to life around the offering, and the restless emotions feeding Bloodlust are drawn away with it. The Bloodhunter feels their breathing steady, their heartbeat return to a measured rhythm, and the chaos within their soul settle into calm determination.

This technique is often performed during the most desperate moments of battle. A Bloodhunter standing on the brink of Bloodlust may willingly sacrifice their own life to regain the strength needed to continue the hunt while restoring control over the darkness within. Every use is a reminder that the greatest enemy a Bloodhunter will ever face is not standing before them—it lives within their own blood.

Among the Orders, only the most disciplined masters are entrusted with this ritual. They teach that Blood Tithe is not a means of escaping Bloodlust forever, but a sacred reminder that every hunter must choose, time and time again, whether they will command their blood or become enslaved by it.

### Effects

- As a **Bonus Action**, activate Blood Tithe.
- Sacrifice **30 HP**.
- Choose **one** of the following:
  - Restore **80 Mana Points (MP)**.
  - Restore **80 Stamina Points (SP)**.
- Reduce your current **Blood Points (BP)** by **25**.
- Blood Tithe cannot restore HP.
- Blood Tithe cannot restore MP or SP beyond their normal maximum values.
- Blood Tithe may only be used while you have at least **25 Blood Points**.

### Lore

The Fifth Rank of Blood Tithe is known throughout the Bloodhunter Orders as **The Final Offering**. It is regarded as the highest demonstration of restraint a Bloodhunter can achieve, proving that even after embracing unimaginable power through Sangramancy, they still possess the wisdom to temper it through sacrifice.

Legends tell of Bloodhunters who stood alone against impossible odds, repeatedly offering their own lifeblood to remain standing while Bloodlust clawed at the edges of their soul. Their victories were never remembered because they possessed greater strength than other warriors, but because they possessed greater control over themselves.

The elders leave every Bloodhunter with one final lesson before teaching this ritual. Sangramancy will always answer the call of blood, but it cares nothing for the one who makes the offering. Only discipline separates a master from a monster, and Blood Tithe exists to ensure that, no matter how powerful a Bloodhunter becomes, they never forget that sacrifice has always been the true price of their strength.

> *"The strongest Bloodhunter is not the one who spills the most blood... but the one who knows exactly how much of their own they are willing to give."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

# Mark of the Quarry

## Overview
Every Bloodhunter understands that a hunt truly begins the moment prey is chosen. Through Sangramancy, the Bloodhunter offers a small portion of their own blood, weaving it into the life force of a single creature. This crimson bond is known as the **Mark of the Quarry**—a supernatural connection that allows the hunter to relentlessly pursue their chosen prey.

Unlike ordinary tracking magic, the mark is not placed upon the creature's body alone. It binds to the creature's blood itself. As long as the creature lives, the Bloodhunter can instinctively feel the connection, making every strike more precise and every movement more deliberate. To the Bloodhunter, there is no longer a battlefield filled with enemies—only the quarry.

The mark also serves as the foundation of every advanced Sangramancy technique. Blood Scent becomes easier to follow, Veinlock grips tighter, and the Bloodhunter's predatory instincts sharpen whenever confronting their chosen target. Every lesson taught within the Bloodhunter Orders begins with the same principle: one hunter, one quarry.

The ritual is not without cost. Every mark requires a willing blood sacrifice and stirs the emotions carried within the Bloodhunter's soul. The hunt becomes deeply personal, and the satisfaction of finally bringing down the marked creature only fuels the growing danger of Bloodlust.

## Rank 1
### Description

Every Bloodhunter understands that a hunt truly begins the moment prey is chosen. Through Sangramancy, the Bloodhunter offers a small portion of their own blood, weaving it into the life force of a single creature. This crimson bond is known as the **Mark of the Quarry**—a supernatural connection that allows the hunter to relentlessly pursue their chosen prey.

Unlike ordinary tracking magic, the mark is not placed upon the creature's body alone. It binds to the creature's blood itself. As long as the creature lives, the Bloodhunter can instinctively feel the connection, making every strike more precise and every movement more deliberate. To the Bloodhunter, there is no longer a battlefield filled with enemies—only the quarry.

The mark also serves as the foundation of every advanced Sangramancy technique. Blood Scent becomes easier to follow, Veinlock grips tighter, and the Bloodhunter's predatory instincts sharpen whenever confronting their chosen target. Every lesson taught within the Bloodhunter Orders begins with the same principle: one hunter, one quarry.

The ritual is not without cost. Every mark requires a willing blood sacrifice and stirs the emotions carried within the Bloodhunter's soul. The hunt becomes deeply personal, and the satisfaction of finally bringing down the marked creature only fuels the growing danger of Bloodlust.

### Effects

- As a **Bonus Action**, mark one creature within **20 metres** as your **Marked Quarry**.
- Spend **15 MP**, sacrifice **5 HP**, and gain **5 Blood Points (BP)**.
- You may only have **one Marked Quarry** at a time.
- The mark remains until:
  - The target dies.
  - You mark another creature.
  - You complete a **Long Rest**.
- Gain **+1 to Attack Rolls** against your **Marked Quarry**.
- Gain **+2 Damage** against your **Marked Quarry**.
- Your **Blood Scent** automatically recognises the blood of your Marked Quarry while the mark remains active.
- Any Bloodhunter talent that references your **Marked Quarry** may target this creature.
- When your Marked Quarry is reduced to **0 HP**, immediately gain **10 Blood Points (BP)**.

### Lore

The first lesson taught to every Bloodhunter apprentice is simple: never divide your attention between multiple hunts. A distracted hunter is a dead hunter. Mark of the Quarry embodies this philosophy, teaching absolute focus upon a single foe until the hunt reaches its conclusion.

Veteran Bloodhunters often describe the mark as a quiet whisper carried through the blood. It is not a voice, nor a vision, but an instinct that constantly reminds the hunter where their purpose lies. Every heartbeat strengthens the connection until hunter and quarry become inseparably bound.

Many Bloodhunters have fallen to Bloodlust after allowing the thrill of a successful hunt to consume them. For this reason, the elders teach that the mark is more than a hunting technique—it is a test of discipline. The Bloodhunter must learn to end the hunt without allowing the hunt to consume them.

> *"A hunter without a quarry is merely a warrior. A Bloodhunter chooses one life... and does not stop until its final heartbeat."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 2
### Description

As a Bloodhunter's mastery of Sangramancy grows, so too does the strength of the bond forged between hunter and quarry. The Mark of the Quarry no longer serves merely as a declaration of intent—it becomes a supernatural tether that strengthens every instinct the Bloodhunter possesses. The marked creature's blood resonates with the hunter's own, making it increasingly difficult for the quarry to escape the inevitable conclusion of the hunt.

The Bloodhunter begins to anticipate the movements of their quarry with frightening accuracy. Every subtle shift in posture, every desperate attempt to flee, and every hesitation in combat seems almost instinctive to read. To outsiders, this appears to be incredible skill, but experienced Bloodhunters know the truth—it is the blood itself revealing the path of the hunt.

The connection between hunter and quarry also strengthens the Bloodhunter's Sangramancy. Techniques such as Blood Scent, Blood Rush, Veinlock, and Hunter's Bane become increasingly effective when directed towards the marked creature, rewarding the Bloodhunter for maintaining focus on a single target.

The Bloodhunter Orders teach that this unwavering focus is both a strength and a danger. Obsession is never far from purpose, and every successful hunt feeds the emotions that slowly build towards Bloodlust.

### Effects

- As a **Bonus Action**, mark one creature within **25 metres** as your **Marked Quarry**.
- Spend **20 MP**, sacrifice **8 HP**, and gain **10 Blood Points (BP)**.
- You may only have **one Marked Quarry** at a time.
- The mark remains until:
  - The target dies.
  - You mark another creature.
  - You complete a **Long Rest**.
- Gain **+2 to Attack Rolls** against your **Marked Quarry**.
- Gain **+3 Damage** against your **Marked Quarry**.
- Your **Blood Scent** automatically recognises the blood of your Marked Quarry while the mark remains active.
- Any Bloodhunter talent that references your **Marked Quarry** may target this creature.
- You always know the **general direction** of your Marked Quarry while it remains on the same plane of existence.
- When your Marked Quarry is reduced to **0 HP**, immediately gain **15 Blood Points (BP)**.

### Lore

Within the Bloodhunter Orders, the Second Rank is known as the point where the hunter truly begins to understand the meaning of pursuit. The mark is no longer simply placed upon a creature—it becomes a bond written into blood itself. No matter how desperately the quarry runs, the Bloodhunter feels the faint pull of the connection guiding them onward.

Veteran Bloodhunters describe the sensation as hearing a distant heartbeat that never truly fades. It is subtle, almost impossible for others to comprehend, yet unmistakable to the hunter who forged the bond. Every step taken by the quarry strengthens the Bloodhunter's resolve to see the hunt through to its inevitable end.

The elders often remind apprentices that Mark of the Quarry is not permission to become obsessed. A hunter who cannot let go after the hunt is finished has already begun walking the path towards Bloodlust. The mark exists to focus the hunt—not to consume the hunter.

> *"The quarry may lose sight of me... but it can never escape the blood that binds us together."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 3
### Description

By the Third Rank, the Mark of the Quarry has become an inseparable extension of the Bloodhunter's Sangramancy. The moment the ritual is completed, a fragment of the Bloodhunter's lifeblood intertwines with that of their chosen prey, creating a bond that neither distance nor deception can easily sever. To the Bloodhunter, the hunt has already begun—the only question remaining is how long the quarry can survive.

The Bloodhunter's instincts sharpen dramatically while confronting their Marked Quarry. Every movement, every hesitation, and every drop of blood spilled reinforces the supernatural connection between hunter and prey. The Bloodhunter no longer reacts to the battle; they anticipate it, predicting the quarry's actions through the rhythm of its blood.

This deeper bond also strengthens every Sangramancy technique the Bloodhunter possesses. Blood Rush drives them relentlessly towards the quarry, Veinlock seizes their blood with greater precision, Blood Scent recognises even the faintest trace of their lifeblood, and Hunter's Bane pushes the Bloodhunter ever closer to perfection against their chosen foe.

Yet such focus carries a terrible danger. The stronger the bond becomes, the greater the exhilaration when the hunt is finally complete. Every successful kill floods the Bloodhunter with powerful emotions, feeding Bloodlust and reminding them that obsession is never far removed from purpose.

### Effects

- As a **Bonus Action**, mark one creature within **30 metres** as your **Marked Quarry**.
- Spend **30 MP**, sacrifice **12 HP**, and gain **15 Blood Points (BP)**.
- You may only have **one Marked Quarry** at a time.
- The mark remains until:
  - The target dies.
  - You mark another creature.
  - You complete a **Long Rest**.
- Gain **+3 to Attack Rolls** against your **Marked Quarry**.
- Gain **+4 Damage** against your **Marked Quarry**.
- Your **Blood Scent** automatically recognises the blood of your Marked Quarry while the mark remains active.
- You always know the **general direction and approximate distance** of your Marked Quarry while it remains on the same plane of existence.
- Any Bloodhunter talent that references your **Marked Quarry** may target this creature.
- When your Marked Quarry is reduced to **0 HP**, immediately gain **20 Blood Points (BP)**.

### Lore

Among veteran Bloodhunters, the Third Rank is known as **The Crimson Bond**. At this stage, the connection between hunter and quarry transcends ordinary tracking, becoming an instinct that few outside the Orders could ever understand. The Bloodhunter no longer searches for the quarry—they simply follow the pull of blood.

Many monsters have attempted to flee across kingdoms, hide beneath ancient ruins, or vanish into enchanted forests, only to discover that the Bloodhunter never truly lost them. As long as the bond endures, every heartbeat of the quarry echoes faintly within the hunter's own blood.

The elders teach that the Crimson Bond is one of Sangramancy's greatest gifts—and one of its greatest temptations. A Bloodhunter who allows the bond to become obsession may eventually forget why they hunt at all. The greatest masters remember that the mark exists to protect the innocent, never to satisfy the darkness within.

> *"The mark does not tell me where you are. It reminds me that the hunt is not finished."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 4
### Description

At the Fourth Rank, the Mark of the Quarry becomes an unbreakable crimson covenant between hunter and prey. Sangramancy no longer simply identifies a target—it entwines the Bloodhunter's soul with the rhythm of the quarry's lifeblood, creating a supernatural bond that grows stronger with every passing heartbeat.

The Bloodhunter no longer needs to actively search for weakness. Their instincts naturally guide every strike toward vulnerable openings, every movement is calculated to deny escape, and every wound inflicted strengthens the relentless pressure of the hunt. To the quarry, it feels as though the Bloodhunter already knows every decision before it is made.

The mark also amplifies every Sangramantic technique the Bloodhunter possesses. Blood Rush becomes an unstoppable pursuit, Veinlock grips tighter as blood answers the Bloodhunter's will, and Blood Scent can distinguish the quarry's blood from every other creature, even after countless battles. There is no confusion, no hesitation—only the certainty that the hunt has already been decided.

Masters warn that this level of focus borders dangerously on obsession. The stronger the bond becomes, the greater the exhilaration when the quarry finally falls. Only the most disciplined Bloodhunters remember that the mark exists to serve justice, not to satisfy Bloodlust.

### Effects

- As a **Bonus Action**, mark one creature within **35 metres** as your **Marked Quarry**.
- Spend **40 MP**, sacrifice **16 HP**, and gain **20 Blood Points (BP)**.
- You may only have **one Marked Quarry** at a time.
- The mark remains until:
  - The target dies.
  - You mark another creature.
  - You complete a **Long Rest**.
- Gain **+4 to Attack Rolls** against your **Marked Quarry**.
- Gain **+5 Damage** against your **Marked Quarry**.
- Your **Blood Scent** automatically recognises the blood of your Marked Quarry while the mark remains active.
- You always know the **direction and approximate distance** of your Marked Quarry while it remains on the same plane of existence.
- Your **Marked Quarry** has **Disadvantage** on ability checks made to hide, disguise, or conceal evidence of its blood from you.
- Any Bloodhunter talent that references your **Marked Quarry** may target this creature.
- When your **Marked Quarry** is reduced to **0 HP**, immediately gain **25 Blood Points (BP)**.

### Lore

Within the Bloodhunter Orders, Rank IV is known as **The Crimson Oath**. Bloodhunters who achieve this mastery are feared not because they are stronger than other warriors, but because once they have chosen their quarry, they rarely fail to complete the hunt. Escape becomes an illusion, and every passing hour only strengthens the hunter's resolve.

Legends tell of Bloodhunters pursuing their quarry across continents, through ancient ruins, and into the darkest corners of the world. Distance becomes meaningless when blood itself remembers the bond that was forged. Even after weeks of pursuit, the Bloodhunter can still sense the faint pull guiding them toward the creature they swore to destroy.

The elders teach that this rank represents the greatest test of discipline before true mastery. The Bloodhunter must never allow the hunt to define who they are. They are protectors first, hunters second. Those who forget this truth eventually discover that Bloodlust no longer cares who has been marked—it only cares that blood continues to flow.

> *"Once I write your name in blood, the world itself becomes your prison."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 5
### Description

The Fifth Rank of Mark of the Quarry is the pinnacle of the Bloodhunter's hunting discipline. Through absolute mastery of Sangramancy, the Bloodhunter no longer merely marks a creature—they forge an unbreakable covenant written in blood itself. The moment the ritual is complete, the quarry becomes the sole focus of the hunt, bound to the Bloodhunter until one of them falls.

At this level, the Bloodhunter's instincts transcend ordinary perception. Every heartbeat of the quarry seems to echo through the hunter's own veins, guiding their movements with terrifying precision. Every strike naturally seeks weakness, every pursuit is relentless, and every attempt to escape feels futile. To the quarry, it is as though death itself has chosen to follow.

The Mark strengthens every Sangramantic technique the Bloodhunter possesses. Blood Rush drives the hunter ever closer, Blood Scent can identify the quarry from the faintest trace of blood, Veinlock manipulates its lifeblood with frightening efficiency, and Hunter's Bane reaches its full destructive potential. Every talent exists to serve the hunt.

Yet this mastery carries the greatest temptation of all. The overwhelming exhilaration of pursuing and finally defeating the Marked Quarry floods the Bloodhunter with Blood Points, pushing them dangerously close to Bloodlust. Masters teach that reaching this rank is not about learning to hunt monsters—it is about proving that the monster within will never become the one choosing the quarry.

### Effects

- As a **Bonus Action**, mark one creature within **40 metres** as your **Marked Quarry**.
- Spend **50 MP**, sacrifice **20 HP**, and gain **25 Blood Points (BP)**.
- You may only have **one Marked Quarry** at a time.
- The mark remains until:
  - The target dies.
  - You mark another creature.
  - You complete a **Long Rest**.
- Gain **+5 to Attack Rolls** against your **Marked Quarry**.
- Gain **+6 Damage** against your **Marked Quarry**.
- You always know the **direction and approximate distance** of your Marked Quarry while it remains on the same plane of existence.
- Your **Blood Scent** automatically recognises your Marked Quarry regardless of how old the blood trail is.
- Your **Marked Quarry** cannot gain Advantage on checks or abilities made to hide, disguise, or evade you through non-magical means.
- All Bloodhunter talents that reference your **Marked Quarry** gain their maximum benefits against this creature.
- When your **Marked Quarry** is reduced to **0 HP**, immediately gain **30 Blood Points (BP)**.

### Lore

Among the Bloodhunter Orders, the Fifth Rank is known as **The Crimson Verdict**. Very few hunters ever achieve this level of mastery, for it demands complete understanding of both Sangramancy and the discipline required to wield it. Those who do are spoken of in hushed voices, for once they have chosen their quarry, the hunt is considered all but inevitable.

Ancient records tell of Bloodhunters pursuing dragons across mountain ranges, vampires through forgotten kingdoms, and eldritch horrors into realms untouched by mortal hands. Distance, deception, and time become meaningless when blood itself remembers the oath that has been sworn.

The elders teach one final lesson before granting this knowledge. The Mark of the Quarry is not permission to kill—it is a promise to finish what must be done. A Bloodhunter who marks out of hatred, vengeance, or obsession has already begun surrendering to Bloodlust. The greatest hunters are remembered not because they never failed, but because they always remained masters of their own blood.

> *"The mark is not your sentence. It is my promise that this hunt will have an end."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

# Blood Reprisal

## Overview
Every Bloodhunter knows that pain is inevitable. The difference between an ordinary warrior and a Bloodhunter is what they choose to do with that pain. Through Sangramancy, the Bloodhunter learns to transform the shock of an enemy's strike into an immediate and devastating retaliation.

The instant the Bloodhunter is wounded, the blood spilled from the injury surges with crimson energy instead of falling harmlessly to the ground. That surge of Sangramancy fuels a burst of instinctive aggression, allowing the hunter to answer the attack before the enemy can recover their footing.

Blood Reprisal is not born from anger alone. It is the culmination of discipline, timing, and absolute trust in one's own blood. Rather than recoiling from injury, the Bloodhunter steps into it, accepting the wound as the price of creating an opening. To outsiders this appears reckless, but to experienced Bloodhunters every wound is simply another opportunity to end the hunt.

- This attack gains **+2 to the Attack Roll**.
- If the attack hits, it deals an additional **+2 damage**.
- Blood Reprisal may only be used **once every 3 Combat Rounds**.
- This attack benefits from all bonuses against your **Marked Quarry**, if applicable.

### Lore

Among the Bloodhunter Orders, Blood Reprisal is often described as the moment a hunter stops fearing pain. Apprentices spend months learning not to flinch after receiving a blow, instead conditioning themselves to recognise that every committed attack leaves the enemy exposed for the briefest of moments.

Veteran Bloodhunters become infamous for this technique. Many monsters quickly realise that striking a Bloodhunter is often the most dangerous decision they can make, for every successful wound is answered by an immediate counterstroke empowered by Sangramancy itself.

The elders warn that Blood Reprisal is intoxicating. There is a dangerous satisfaction in turning suffering into violence, and many Bloodhunters who fall to Bloodlust first became addicted to the thrill of retaliation rather than the discipline required to master it.

> *"Every wound you give me is another chance for me to end this hunt."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 2
### Description

As the Bloodhunter's understanding of Sangramancy deepens, Blood Reprisal becomes more than an instinctive counterattack—it becomes a calculated punishment for those foolish enough to draw the hunter's blood. Every wound suffered is immediately analysed, every opening recognised, and every heartbeat prepares the Bloodhunter to answer with lethal precision.

The Bloodhunter no longer recoils from pain. Instead, injury fuels their focus, allowing them to retaliate with greater speed and accuracy than before. The blood spilled from their wounds surges with Sangramantic energy, briefly strengthening both body and mind before exploding into a devastating counterstrike.

Experienced Bloodhunters deliberately remain close to dangerous foes, knowing that every committed attack creates a fleeting weakness. Their enemies soon realise a terrifying truth: striking the Bloodhunter often places them in greater danger than the hunter themselves.

Yet every reprisal strengthens the emotional current flowing through the Bloodhunter's blood. Satisfaction, anger, determination, and exhilaration all feed Bloodlust, reminding the hunter that even justified vengeance comes with a price.

### Effects

- **Reaction:** Activate Blood Reprisal immediately after taking damage from a creature within your melee reach.
- Spend **25 MP** and gain **15 Blood Points (BP)**.
- Immediately make **one melee weapon attack** against the creature that damaged you.
- Gain **+3 to the Attack Roll** for this attack.
- If the attack hits, it deals an additional **+4 damage**.
- If the target is your **Marked Quarry**, gain an additional **+1 Attack Roll**.
- Blood Reprisal may only be used **once every 3 Combat Rounds**.
- This attack benefits from all bonuses granted by **Blood Rite**, **Hunter's Bane**, and other Bloodhunter talents.

### Lore

Within the Bloodhunter Orders, Rank II marks the point where Blood Reprisal becomes a feared combat technique rather than a desperate reaction. Veteran hunters no longer view taking a wound as failure—they recognise it as an opportunity. Every enemy that overextends themselves has unknowingly offered the Bloodhunter the perfect opening.

Many monsters learn this lesson only once. Those that survive often become hesitant to strike first, wary that every successful blow may be answered by an even deadlier retaliation. This hesitation alone has allowed countless Bloodhunters to seize control of battles that once seemed unwinnable.

The elders teach that Blood Reprisal must never become an excuse to seek injury. A Bloodhunter survives not because they enjoy pain, but because they have mastered the discipline to transform suffering into victory. The moment pain becomes something to chase, Bloodlust has already begun tightening its grip.

> *"Every scar teaches the same lesson... strike me once, and you'll remember why you should have struck harder."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 3
### Description

By the Third Rank, Blood Reprisal has become second nature to the Bloodhunter. The moment blood is spilled, Sangramancy instinctively courses through the wound, transforming pain into purpose before the Bloodhunter has time to think. Every strike suffered becomes an opportunity to retaliate with ruthless efficiency.

The Bloodhunter no longer views incoming attacks as moments to endure, but as openings to exploit. As an enemy's weapon completes its swing, their balance shifts, their guard weakens, and for a single heartbeat they become vulnerable. Sangramancy amplifies the Bloodhunter's instincts, allowing them to seize that fleeting opportunity with terrifying speed.

Those who witness a master of Blood Reprisal often describe it as though the Bloodhunter welcomes injury. This is not recklessness, but supreme confidence. They know exactly how much pain they can endure, and they understand that every wound accepted on their own terms can become the beginning of their enemy's downfall.

Yet this technique carries a dangerous temptation. The exhilaration of answering pain with violence becomes increasingly addictive, and every successful reprisal drives Blood Points higher, bringing the Bloodhunter ever closer to Bloodlust.

### Effects

- **Reaction:** Activate Blood Reprisal immediately after taking damage from a creature within your melee reach.
- Spend **35 MP** and gain **20 Blood Points (BP)**.
- Immediately make **one melee weapon attack** against the creature that damaged you.
- Gain **+4 to the Attack Roll** for this attack.
- If the attack hits, it deals an additional **+6 damage**.
- If the target is your **Marked Quarry**, gain an additional **+2 to the Attack Roll**.
- If Blood Reprisal reduces your **Marked Quarry** to **0 HP**, immediately reduce your current **Blood Points** by **10 BP**, as the hunt reaches its satisfying conclusion.
- Blood Reprisal may only be used **once every 2 Combat Rounds**.
- This attack benefits from all bonuses granted by **Blood Rite**, **Hunter's Bane**, **Mark of the Quarry**, and other Bloodhunter talents.

### Lore

Within the Bloodhunter Orders, Rank III is known as **The Crimson Retaliation**. It is the point where a Bloodhunter no longer fears the enemy's first strike, for they know it will almost certainly be answered before their opponent can recover. Many monsters have won the opening exchange of a battle, only to lose the fight moments later to the Bloodhunter's relentless counterattack.

Masters teach that Blood Reprisal is not a technique born from anger, but from discipline. Every movement has been practised countless times, every counterstrike refined until it becomes instinct. The Bloodhunter does not retaliate because they are enraged—they retaliate because they have already accepted the pain as part of the hunt.

The elders warn that Blood Reprisal represents one of Sangramancy's greatest temptations. There is a dangerous satisfaction in turning suffering into victory, and only those with absolute self-control can wield this technique without allowing Bloodlust to transform justice into vengeance.

> *"Pain is merely the signal. Retribution is the answer."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 4
### Description

The Fourth Rank of Blood Reprisal is feared even among veteran monster hunters. At this level, Sangramancy no longer merely responds to pain—it anticipates it. The instant an enemy's attack lands, the Bloodhunter's blood surges with crimson power, their body instinctively moving to exploit the opening left behind by the attacker.

Every wound becomes a calculated exchange. The Bloodhunter willingly accepts the enemy's strike, trusting in years of discipline to transform that moment of vulnerability into overwhelming retaliation. To the untrained eye, it appears reckless. To a master Bloodhunter, it is absolute control over both body and blood.

As Sangramancy flows through the Bloodhunter's veins, the exhilaration of immediate vengeance grows stronger than ever. Every successful reprisal feeds the emotions carried within the blood, rapidly increasing Blood Points while reinforcing the dangerous satisfaction of answering pain with greater violence. Only those with unwavering discipline can prevent this intoxicating cycle from becoming Bloodlust.

Within the Bloodhunter Orders, Rank IV is considered the final trial before true mastery. Those who survive long enough to perfect Blood Reprisal become living reminders that the greatest mistake a monster can make is believing a wounded Bloodhunter has become weaker.

### Effects

- **Reaction:** Activate Blood Reprisal immediately after taking damage from a creature within your melee reach.
- Spend **45 MP** and gain **25 Blood Points (BP)**.
- Immediately make **one melee weapon attack** against the creature that damaged you.
- Gain **+5 to the Attack Roll** for this attack.
- If the attack hits, it deals an additional **+8 damage**.
- If the target is your **Marked Quarry**, gain an additional **+2 to the Attack Roll** and **+2 Damage**.
- If Blood Reprisal reduces your **Marked Quarry** to **0 HP**, immediately reduce your current **Blood Points** by **15 BP**.
- Blood Reprisal may only be used **once every 2 Combat Rounds**.
- This attack benefits from all bonuses granted by **Blood Rite**, **Hunter's Bane**, **Mark of the Quarry**, and other Bloodhunter talents.

### Lore

Among the Bloodhunter Orders, Rank IV is known as **The Crimson Counterstroke**. Hunters who reach this level have mastered the art of turning suffering into opportunity. Their enemies soon learn that every successful blow only increases the danger they face, as each wound fuels a retaliation of terrifying precision.

Stories tell of Bloodhunters who stood against creatures many times their size, allowing a single strike to land before delivering the decisive counterattack that ended the battle. Such victories are remembered not because the Bloodhunter endured the pain, but because they possessed the discipline to transform it into purpose.

The elders teach that Blood Reprisal is never an excuse to seek injury. A master does not invite pain—they simply refuse to waste it. The Bloodhunter who forgets this distinction will eventually stop hunting monsters and begin chasing the thrill of retaliation itself, the first true step toward Bloodlust.

> *"Every wound is an invitation. Every reprisal is my reply."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 5
### Description

The Fifth Rank of Blood Reprisal is the pinnacle of retaliatory Sangramancy. At this stage, the Bloodhunter has forged an unbreakable connection between pain and purpose. Every wound suffered becomes a catalyst for immediate vengeance, allowing the Bloodhunter to answer violence with greater violence before their enemy has even recovered from the strike.

The Bloodhunter no longer reacts consciously. The moment blood is drawn, Sangramancy surges through every vein, driving muscles into motion with supernatural precision. Every counterattack is swift, deliberate, and devastating, transforming what should have been a moment of weakness into the greatest danger the enemy will face.

To seasoned monsters, the sight of a Bloodhunter refusing to stagger after suffering a grievous wound is deeply unsettling. They know what comes next. The crimson glow spreading through the Bloodhunter's veins is not a sign of desperation—it is the warning that Blood Reprisal has already begun.

Only the greatest Bloodhunters are entrusted with this technique. The exhilaration of turning agony into triumph is intoxicating, flooding the body with Blood Points at an alarming rate. Masters constantly remind their apprentices that the purpose of Blood Reprisal is to end the hunt swiftly—not to become addicted to the satisfaction of revenge.

### Effects

- **Reaction:** Activate Blood Reprisal immediately after taking damage from a creature within your melee reach.
- Spend **60 MP** and gain **30 Blood Points (BP)**.
- Immediately make **one melee weapon attack** against the creature that damaged you.
- Gain **+6 to the Attack Roll** for this attack.
- If the attack hits, it deals an additional **+10 damage**.
- If the target is your **Marked Quarry**, gain an additional **+2 to the Attack Roll** and **+4 Damage**.
- If Blood Reprisal reduces your **Marked Quarry** to **0 HP**, immediately reduce your current **Blood Points** by **20 BP**.
- Blood Reprisal may be used **once every Combat Round**, but only **once per triggering attack**.
- This attack benefits from all bonuses granted by **Blood Rite**, **Hunter's Bane**, **Mark of the Quarry**, and all other applicable Bloodhunter talents.

### Lore

Within the Bloodhunter Orders, the Fifth Rank is known as **The Crimson Reckoning**. It is spoken of with equal measures of admiration and caution, for only those who possess absolute discipline can wield such overwhelming retaliation without allowing Bloodlust to consume them. Every strike against these masters becomes a gamble few enemies survive.

Legends recount Bloodhunters standing alone against dragons, elder vampires, and eldritch horrors, each devastating blow answered by an even more terrifying reprisal. Their enemies soon learned that drawing a Bloodhunter's blood did not bring victory—it merely awakened the deadliest part of the hunt.

The elders teach one final truth before revealing this technique. A Bloodhunter is not defined by how much pain they endure, nor by how fiercely they retaliate. They are defined by their ability to choose when vengeance serves justice and when restraint serves it better. Only those who never forget this distinction can truly master Blood Reprisal.

> *"You mistake my blood for a weakness. It is simply the price you pay to earn my full attention."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor
